answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a slashable identity bond. Each agent locks a jade stake as collateral, and voting weight equals locked capital, never headcount. Honest votes weave a thread of attestations that peers can verify; a fake vine of cloned agents must fund a fresh bond per identity. The attacker pays linearly for every false node, and any detected fraud slashes the whole stake, so scaling the attack scales the loss.
